Question: Brenda and Sally run in opposite directions on a circular track, starting at diametrically opposite points. They first meet after Brenda has run \(100\) meters. They next meet after Sally has run \(150\) meters past their first meeting point. Each girl runs at a constant speed. What is the length of the track in meters?
